listing.name: Super Robot Taisen 64 (Marchwind 64)
listing.summary: Upstream route: Windows (experimental), Linux and macOS Apple Silicon packages; owned JP ROM Limits: Normal release0.4.10 distinct from Vulkan test tags; Windows/SteamDeck/Android experimental. Upstream platforms: Windows x86-64 experimental package, Linux package and macOS Apple-Silicon ARM64 package; Linux CPU unknown in frozen research. Android/SteamDeck experimental. Original data: Own Super Robot Taisen 64 Japanese N64 revision 0 cartridge dump. The runtime loads player-supplied game data; English/Chinese translation support is an optional port feature, not a requirement to obtain a patched commercial ROM. The reviewed README does not itself establish the complete accepted ROM digest. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
